sites.name: Gobi desert

sites.name: Central Svalbard

sites.name: Central Iceland

sites.name: Amazon / Manaus vicinity

sites.name: Congo Basin
sites.rationale: Warm wet tropical forest.

sites.name: Central Borneo
sites.rationale: Warm wet tropical forest and mountain context.

sites.name: Finnish Lapland
sites.rationale: Cold forested terrain; should not be classified as bare polar desert.

sites.name: Central Iowa
sites.rationale: Temperate agricultural landscape; hot summers alone should not suffice.

sites.name: Central Uruguay
sites.rationale: Humid grassland/agricultural landscape.

sites.name: Serengeti region
sites.rationale: Warm seasonal savanna; sparse tree cover alone should not count as barren.

sites.name: Mekong Delta
sites.rationale: Warm wet low-slope agriculture and water; tests flat/hot confounders.

sites.name: Tokyo region
sites.rationale: Warm built-up/coastal landscape; tests hot urban surface confounders.

sites.name: Central Alps
sites.rationale: Cold rocky mountainous terrain with ice; tests steep/wet confounders.

sites.name: Everest / central Himalaya
sites.rationale: Very high rocky/icy mountains; cold bare areas need not provide a low-slope usable footprint.

sites.name: Greenland interior ice sheet
sites.rationale: Cold dry ice sheet; should fail the bare-ground requirement.

sites.name: Equatorial central Pacific
sites.rationale: Open ocean; missing land-cover coverage must not become a barren zero.

sites.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys vicinity
sites.rationale: Plausible cold-desert setting outside EarthEnv terrain and northern permafrost domains; expected data-driven rejection, not evidence of unsuitability.

sites.name: Almeria / southeast Spain
